tells.1: Filler justification 'to give you more options' tacked onto the class announcement.
tells.2: A templated purpose clause, 'to give you more options during the week', doesn't fit Sunday classes. 'As a current member' also assumes every recipient is one.
tells.4: Forced warmth: 'Quick heads-up', 'On a happier note' (which frames the price rise as bad news), and the stock closer 'we'll be glad to help'.

reason: Version 5 gives both prices, both dates, and the current-member exception in two plain sentences, with no padding or spin, which suits a short business notice. Version 3 is nearly as clean, while 2 and 4 add template phrasing or overcompensating cheer.
